newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Gilts look to upside, target 110-16.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Gilts look to upside, target 110-16.

text.p: June gilt futures have gained enough momentum to push higher on Wednesday and should be able to crack 110-00 and head for resistance around 110-16, technical analysts said.
"The fact that we broke 109-21 yesterday and managed to hold it at the close is pretty encouraging for gilts," said David Wood, an independent technical analyst based near London.
"So obvious support is at 109-18,21 where we broke out yesterday -- we've struggled to get through there for a while so it should turn into immediate support now."
The June gilt opened up 5/32 at 109-29.
Wood said below 109-18, a strong band of support at 109-12 to 109-08 would kick in.
"That shouldn't give way, so we've got a problem if it does," he said.
On the upside, Wood was optimistic the market would be able to pierce psychological resistance at 110-00 before heading for 110-16,19, a resistance area from the middle of March.

"Bunds, gilts and BTPs have all managed to break through their congestion areas, so European markets are looking pretty buoyant at the moment," he said. "It may be a bit overdone perhaps so we may see some small consolidation."
Analysts at Chase said while Tuesday's move up had improved the technical outlook for gilts, the market would still struggle to break trendline resistance on weekly charts at 110-01.
"The anticipated correction from levels below 110-01 will find support in the 109-16/08 congestion area and from here it should put 110-01 under pressure," Chase said in a note.
It said a break of 110-01 would open initial upside potential to 110-08 and once above there, would test Elliott resistance at 110-28.
By 0727 GMT, June short sterling was down one basis point at 93.42.
